citations.title: Jeff Miller

sentences.text: Jeffrey A. Miller is Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer of Halliburton, the Houston-based oilfield services company.

sentences.quote: Mr. Miller joined Halliburton in 1997, working in various leadership roles of increasing responsibility and oversight, including serving on our Board of Directors since 2014. From 2014 to 2017, he served as President and Chief Health, Safety and Environment Officer. From 2017 to 2018, Mr. Miller served as President and CEO; beginning in 2019, he has served as Halliburton's Chairman of the Board, President and CEO.
sentences.text: He joined Halliburton in 1997, has served on its board since 2014, held the roles of President and Chief Health, Safety and Environment Officer from 2014 to 2017, became President and CEO in 2017, and has served as Chairman, President and CEO since 2019.

Earlier positions included Chief Operating Officer, Senior Vice President of Business Development, Regional Vice President of the Gulf of Mexico, and Operations Vice President of Angola and Indonesia.

sentences.quote: Mr. Miller has extensive experience leading energy industry business efforts in every region of the world, including specific assignments living in Angola, Indonesia, Venezuela, and Dubai. He leads Halliburton's strategy and direction.
sentences.text: His career has included assignments living in Angola, Indonesia, Venezuela and Dubai, and he leads the company's strategy and direction.
He holds a Bachelor of Science in agriculture and business from McNeese State University and an MBA from Texas A&M University.

citations.title: Halliburton appoints Shannon Slocum as executive vice president and chief operating officer

sentences.quote: Houston, TX - Dec. 4, 2025 - Halliburton (NYSE: HAL) announced today that Shannon Slocum has been promoted to executive vice president and chief operating officer and appointed to the board of directors, effective Jan. 1, 2026.
sentences.text: In December 2025 Halliburton promoted Shannon Slocum to executive vice president and chief operating officer and to the board, effective January 1, 2026, with Rami Yassine succeeding him as president, Eastern Hemisphere; Miller said the strategy "demands execution" and that transferring operations to Slocum let him focus on long-term strategic advancement.
Casey Maxwell, senior vice president North America Land, became president, Western Hemisphere, effective February 1, 2026.
On October 15, 2026 the board appointed David Hernandez as a director, which Miller tied to ongoing board succession and refreshment.
On the second-quarter 2026 call Miller said the global outlook is strong and will drive revenue growth and margin expansion, with energy security a multi-year issue.
